title: Reset a forgotten or expired password
symptoms: User forgot their password
Password expired and login is refused
Error 'The password is incorrect' after a recent change
diagnostic_steps: Confirm the user's identity with the employee verification questions
Check in Active Directory whether the password has expired or the account is locked
Check whether the user changed the password recently on another device
resolution_steps: Ask the user to reset the password at the self-service portal https://reset.corp.example
If self-service is not enrolled, reset the password in Active Directory and tick 'User must change password at next logon'
Tell the user to sign out of all devices and sign in again with the new password
Update the saved password on the phone mail app to stop repeated failed logins
escalation_criteria: Escalate to Identity & Access Management if identity cannot be verified or the reset fails twice.

title: Unlock an account locked after failed sign-ins
symptoms: Error 'Your account has been locked'
User locked out repeatedly every few minutes
Login fails on all applications at the same time
diagnostic_steps: Check the lockout source in the Account Lockout Status tool
Look for an old password saved on a phone, mapped drive or scheduled task
Confirm the lockouts are not from an unknown IP address (possible attack)
resolution_steps: Unlock the account in Active Directory Users and Computers
Remove saved credentials from Windows Credential Manager on the user's laptop
Update or remove the old password on mobile devices that sync email
Monitor the account for 30 minutes to confirm it does not lock again
escalation_criteria: Escalate to the Security Operations Center if lockouts come from unknown IP addresses or countries.

title: Fix multi-factor authentication (MFA) prompts that fail or never arrive
symptoms: Authenticator push notification does not arrive
MFA code is rejected as invalid
User changed phone and lost the authenticator app
diagnostic_steps: Check the user's registered MFA methods in the identity portal
Confirm the phone's date and time are set automatically
Check whether the user recently replaced or reset their phone
resolution_steps: Ask the user to enable automatic date and time on the phone and retry the code
Re-register the authenticator app by removing the old device and scanning a new QR code
Issue a temporary access pass valid for 8 hours if the user has no working method
Ask the user to register a backup method such as SMS
escalation_criteria: Escalate to Identity & Access Management if MFA fails for many users at once (possible service issue).

title: Grant access to an application, shared folder or group
symptoms: Error 'Access denied' or 'You don't have permission'
New joiner cannot open a team folder
User needs a new role in an application
diagnostic_steps: Confirm which resource and which access level are needed
Check that a manager approval exists in the access request form
Check the user's current group memberships
resolution_steps: Raise an access request in the identity portal with the resource and access level
Wait for the resource owner's approval before granting access
Add the user to the approved security group
Ask the user to sign out and sign in again so the new group membership applies
escalation_criteria: Escalate to the resource owner if no approval arrives within 2 business days.

title: VPN client cannot connect
symptoms: GlobalProtect stuck on 'Connecting'
VPN error 809 or 'gateway unreachable'
VPN connects but internal sites do not open
diagnostic_steps: Check the user's internet connection without VPN
Check the VPN client version and whether the certificate has expired
Check the VPN gateway status page for an ongoing outage
resolution_steps: Disconnect and reconnect the VPN, choosing the nearest gateway
Restart the PanGPS service or reboot the laptop
Update the VPN client to the latest approved version from the Software Center
Re-import the machine certificate if the client reports an expired certificate
escalation_criteria: Escalate to Network Operations if several users report the same gateway failing.

title: VPN disconnects frequently or is very slow
symptoms: VPN drops every few minutes
Very slow file transfers over VPN
Video calls freeze only when VPN is on
diagnostic_steps: Run a speed test with and without VPN
Check whether the home router or Wi-Fi signal is weak
Check whether split tunnelling is enabled for video calls
resolution_steps: Connect the laptop to the router with a cable or move closer to the Wi-Fi access point
Switch to the nearest VPN gateway in the client settings
Turn off other VPN or proxy software running at the same time
Restart the home router if the speed test without VPN is also slow
escalation_criteria: Escalate to Network Operations if the gateway shows packet loss for many users.

title: Cannot connect to office Wi-Fi
symptoms: Laptop does not see the CORP-WIFI network
Wi-Fi connected but no internet
Wi-Fi asks for credentials again and again
diagnostic_steps: Check whether other devices nearby can connect
Check whether the laptop's machine certificate is valid
Check the access point status in the wireless controller
resolution_steps: Forget the CORP-WIFI network and connect again
Turn the Wi-Fi adapter off and on, or toggle airplane mode
Update the Wi-Fi driver from the Software Center
Run gpupdate /force to refresh the wireless profile and certificate
escalation_criteria: Escalate to Network Operations if a whole floor or site has no Wi-Fi.

title: Websites or internal servers do not resolve (DNS or connectivity)
symptoms: Error 'DNS_PROBE_FINISHED_NXDOMAIN'
Internal site opens by IP address but not by name
Network drive shows 'path not found'
diagnostic_steps: Run nslookup for the failing host name
Ping the server by IP address to separate DNS from connectivity
Check whether the laptop received the correct DNS servers with ipconfig /all
resolution_steps: Run ipconfig /flushdns and then ipconfig /renew
Reconnect to the network or VPN to receive the correct DNS servers
Remove any manually set DNS server from the network adapter settings
Remap the network drive using the full server name
escalation_criteria: Escalate to Network Operations if nslookup fails for all users or the DNS server does not respond.

title: Website blocked by proxy or firewall
symptoms: Page shows 'Blocked by corporate policy'
Proxy authentication prompt keeps appearing
Connection to an external partner system times out
diagnostic_steps: Check the block page for the category and rule name
Check whether the site is needed for business and who owns the request
Test the connection from another network to confirm a firewall block
resolution_steps: Ask the user for the business reason and the full URL
Raise a firewall or proxy exception request with the URL, port and business owner
Clear the browser cache and restart the browser after the exception is applied
Re-enter the proxy credentials if the authentication prompt keeps appearing
escalation_criteria: Escalate to Network Security if the request involves opening inbound ports or an unknown destination.

title: Laptop is slow, freezes or overheats
symptoms: Laptop takes over 10 minutes to start
Fan is loud and the laptop is hot
Applications freeze and the disk is at 100%
diagnostic_steps: Check CPU, memory and disk usage in Task Manager
Check free disk space on drive C
Run the manufacturer's hardware diagnostics
resolution_steps: Restart the laptop and install pending Windows updates
Free up disk space by clearing temporary files with Disk Cleanup
Disable unnecessary startup programs in Task Manager
Raise a hardware replacement if the diagnostics report a failing disk or battery
escalation_criteria: Escalate to End-User Computing if diagnostics report a hardware fault.

title: Laptop does not power on, no display or blue screen
symptoms: Laptop does not turn on
Black screen after the logo
Blue screen error such as CRITICAL_PROCESS_DIED
diagnostic_steps: Check whether the charger light is on
Connect an external monitor to check the display
Note the blue screen stop code
resolution_steps: Hold the power button for 30 seconds to drain residual power, then start again
Try a different charger to rule out a faulty adapter
Boot into Safe Mode and remove the most recently installed driver or update
Book a loaner laptop and a hardware repair if the laptop still does not start
escalation_criteria: Escalate to End-User Computing for any physical damage or repeated blue screens.

title: Printer not printing or jobs stuck in the queue
symptoms: Print jobs stay in the queue
Printer shows offline
Paper jam or 'toner low' message
diagnostic_steps: Check the printer's display panel for errors
Check whether other users can print to the same printer
Check the print queue on the print server
resolution_steps: Clear the print queue and restart the Print Spooler service
Remove the printer and add it again from the print server
Clear any paper jam following the printer panel instructions
Reinstall the printer driver from the Software Center
escalation_criteria: Escalate to End-User Computing for hardware faults or if a whole floor cannot print.

title: Monitor, docking station, keyboard or mouse not working
symptoms: External monitor shows 'no signal'
Docking station does not detect devices
Keyboard or mouse stops responding
diagnostic_steps: Check the cables and try another port
Test the device on another computer
Check the docking station firmware version
resolution_steps: Disconnect the docking station, wait 10 seconds and connect it again
Update the docking station firmware and display driver from the Software Center
Press Windows+P and select Extend to detect the external monitor
Replace the batteries or receiver of wireless devices
escalation_criteria: Escalate to End-User Computing for a replacement if the device fails on another computer.

title: Outlook does not open, crashes or freezes
symptoms: Outlook stuck on 'Loading profile'
Outlook crashes when opening attachments
Outlook is not responding
diagnostic_steps: Start Outlook in safe mode with outlook.exe /safe
Check whether a recent add-in was installed
Check the size of the OST file
resolution_steps: Start Outlook in safe mode and disable recently added add-ins
Run the Office repair from Apps and Features
Rename the OST file so Outlook rebuilds it on the next start
Create a new Outlook profile if the problem continues
escalation_criteria: Escalate to the Messaging Team if the mailbox is not reachable from Outlook on the web either.

title: Emails not sending, not receiving or mailbox full
symptoms: Emails stuck in the Outbox
Not receiving external emails
Warning 'Your mailbox is almost full'
diagnostic_steps: Check the mailbox size and quota
Check whether Outlook on the web shows the same problem
Run a message trace for the missing email
resolution_steps: Empty Deleted Items and archive old emails to reduce mailbox size
Remove large attachments from the Outbox and send again
Check the Junk folder and blocked senders list for missing emails
Enable online archiving for the mailbox if the quota is reached often
escalation_criteria: Escalate to the Messaging Team if the message trace shows rejected or delayed delivery.

title: SAP GUI login fails or transactions error
symptoms: SAP GUI error 'Partner not reached'
SAP logon fails with 'user locked'
Transaction ends with a short dump
diagnostic_steps: Check whether the SAP system is up on the SAP status page
Check the SAP user status in transaction SU01
Note the transaction code and short dump ID from ST22
resolution_steps: Clear the SAP GUI cache and restart SAP Logon
Unlock the SAP user in SU01 and reset the password if required
Check that the correct system entry is selected in SAP Logon
Send the short dump ID from ST22 to SAP Basis for analysis
escalation_criteria: Escalate to SAP Basis if the system is down or many users get the same short dump.

title: Install or update approved software
symptoms: User needs a new application installed
Installation fails with 'administrator rights required'
Software Center install stuck at 0%
diagnostic_steps: Check whether the software is in the approved software catalogue
Check the Software Center installation log
Check free disk space and pending restarts
resolution_steps: Install the application from the Software Center if it is in the catalogue
Restart the laptop to finish pending updates and retry the installation
Raise a software request with manager approval if the application is not in the catalogue
Clear the Software Center cache if the installation is stuck
escalation_criteria: Escalate to Desktop Engineering if the package fails on several laptops.

title: Business application crashes or shows an error
symptoms: Application closes unexpectedly
Error 'Application has stopped working'
Application hangs after a recent update
diagnostic_steps: Collect the exact error message and a screenshot
Check the Windows Event Viewer application log for the crash
Check whether the crash started after an update
resolution_steps: Restart the application and clear its local cache
Repair or reinstall the application from the Software Center
Roll back the most recent update if the crash started after it
Send the Event Viewer logs to Application Support
escalation_criteria: Escalate to Application Support if the crash affects many users or a production business process.

title: Microsoft Teams calls or meetings not working
symptoms: Teams shows a white screen
Others cannot hear the user in Teams calls
Teams keeps crashing on start
diagnostic_steps: Check whether Teams on the web works
Check the selected microphone and speaker in Teams device settings
Check the Teams version
resolution_steps: Quit Teams completely and clear the Teams cache folder
Select the correct microphone and speaker in Teams device settings
Update Teams to the latest version
Use Teams on the web as a workaround while the desktop app is fixed
escalation_criteria: Escalate to Application Support if Teams on the web also fails.

title: Database queries slow or timing out
symptoms: Reports take much longer than usual
Query timeout errors in the application
High CPU on the database server
diagnostic_steps: Find long-running and blocking sessions on the database
Check CPU, memory and disk I/O on the database server
Review the execution plan of the slow query
resolution_steps: Identify blocking sessions and ask the owner before ending them
Update table statistics and rebuild fragmented indexes
Add a missing index suggested by the execution plan after testing in UAT
Schedule heavy reports outside business hours
escalation_criteria: Escalate to the DBA Team if production performance affects many users.

title: Application cannot connect to the database
symptoms: Error 'ORA-12541: TNS:no listener'
Error 'Login failed for user'
Connection pool exhausted errors
diagnostic_steps: Check whether the database service and listener are running
Test the connection from the application server
Check whether the database account is locked or its password expired
resolution_steps: Restart the database listener if it is not running
Unlock the service account or update its rotated password in the application configuration
Increase the connection pool size or fix connections that are not closed
Check firewall rules between the application server and the database port
escalation_criteria: Escalate to the DBA Team immediately if a production database is unreachable.

title: Database backup failed or a restore is needed
symptoms: Nightly backup job failed
Backup disk is full
User needs data restored to an earlier point in time
diagnostic_steps: Check the backup job history and error message
Check free space on the backup target
Confirm the restore point and the approval from the data owner
resolution_steps: Free space on the backup target and rerun the backup job
Verify the latest successful backup with a restore test
Restore the database to a separate instance first for the requested point in time
Get data owner sign-off before replacing production data
escalation_criteria: Escalate to the DBA Team if two backups in a row fail.

title: How-to requests and general IT questions
symptoms: User asks how to set up an out-of-office reply
User asks how to map a network drive
User asks how to share a file securely
diagnostic_steps: Identify the task the user wants to do
Check the self-help portal for an existing guide
Confirm the user's device and operating system
resolution_steps: Send the user the matching guide from the self-help portal
Walk the user through the steps on a short call if needed
Confirm the user can complete the task alone
Suggest a new self-help article if no guide exists
escalation_criteria: No escalation needed unless the request turns into a fault.

title: Request a software licence
symptoms: User needs a licence for Visio, Project or Adobe
Application says 'licence expired'
Trial version ended
diagnostic_steps: Check whether a free licence is available in the licence pool
Check that the user's manager has approved the cost
Check the licence assignment in the admin portal
resolution_steps: Raise a licence request in the service portal with manager approval
Assign a free licence from the pool if one is available
Ask the user to sign out and sign in to the application to activate the licence
Remove licences from leavers to free them for new requests
escalation_criteria: Escalate to Software Asset Management if no licence is available in the pool.

title: Company phone: email not syncing, enrolment fails or device not compliant
symptoms: Email or Teams stopped syncing on the company phone
Phone cannot be enrolled in the Intune Company Portal
Phone shows 'not compliant' and company apps are blocked
diagnostic_steps: Check the device record in Intune for compliance status and last check-in time
Confirm the phone runs the minimum supported OS version
Check whether the user's licence includes mobile device management
resolution_steps: Open the Company Portal app and tap Check status to force a compliance check
Install pending OS updates and restart the phone
Remove and re-add the work account in the Outlook mobile app
If enrolment still fails, retire the old device record in Intune and enrol the phone again
escalation_criteria: Escalate to Mobile Device Management if the device stays non-compliant after an update and re-enrolment.

title: Lost or stolen company phone
symptoms: User lost the company phone
Company phone was stolen
Phone with company email is missing
diagnostic_steps: Confirm the user's identity and the device in Intune
Ask when and where the phone was last seen
Check whether the phone was used to sign in after it went missing
resolution_steps: Send a remote wipe of company data from Intune
Revoke the user's active sessions and require MFA re-registration
Block the SIM with the mobile carrier
Order a replacement phone through the hardware request form
escalation_criteria: Escalate to Security Operations if the phone was used to sign in after it was lost.

title: OneDrive or SharePoint files not syncing
symptoms: OneDrive files show a red cross or are stuck syncing
Duplicate files appear with the computer name added
A synced SharePoint library stopped updating
diagnostic_steps: Open the OneDrive icon in the taskbar and read the sync error
Check whether the user's OneDrive storage is full
Check for file names with unsupported characters or paths longer than 400 characters
resolution_steps: Pause and resume syncing from the OneDrive icon
Rename files with unsupported characters and shorten long paths
Free OneDrive space by removing old files or making them online-only
Reset OneDrive with onedrive.exe /reset and sign in again
escalation_criteria: Escalate to Collaboration Services if files are missing after sync or the reset does not fix it.

title: Suspicious or phishing email reported
symptoms: Email asks the user to confirm a password through a link
Unexpected invoice or attachment from an unknown sender
Email pretends to be from a manager or executive and asks for money or gift cards
diagnostic_steps: Ask whether the user clicked a link, opened an attachment or entered a password
Check the sender address and message headers
Search the mail system for the same message sent to other users
resolution_steps: Ask the user to report the email with the Report Phishing button and then delete it
If a password was entered, reset it immediately and revoke active sessions
Remove the same message from all mailboxes with a mail purge
Block the sender domain and the linked URL
escalation_criteria: Escalate to Security Operations at once if credentials were entered, an attachment was opened, or many users received it.

title: Antivirus alert, malware or suspected ransomware
symptoms: Microsoft Defender shows a threat detected alert
Unknown programs, pop-ups or browser redirects
Files have strange extensions or a ransom note appears
diagnostic_steps: Check the Defender alert name and the affected file path
Ask whether the user opened an attachment or plugged in a USB device
Check whether other devices show the same alert
resolution_steps: Disconnect the laptop from the network and VPN immediately
Run a full Microsoft Defender scan and quarantine detected items
Do not pay any ransom and do not delete the ransom note
Reimage the laptop if the threat cannot be removed and restore files from backup
escalation_criteria: Escalate to Security Operations immediately for ransomware, repeated detections or more than one affected device.

title: Server or file share running out of disk space
symptoms: Server disk above 90% full
Application stops writing logs or files
Users cannot save files to the department share
diagnostic_steps: Check disk usage per volume in the monitoring tool
Find the largest folders and recently grown files
Check whether log rotation and cleanup jobs are running
resolution_steps: Delete or archive old log files and temporary files
Enable log rotation for the application
Move old data to archive storage
Request a disk extension through a change request if usage is still above 85%
escalation_criteria: Escalate to Infrastructure Operations if the disk cannot be brought below 85% or a production service has stopped.

title: Server or VM not responding
symptoms: Server does not answer ping or RDP
VM is powered off and will not start
Server memory or CPU at 100% and services keep restarting
diagnostic_steps: Check the server status in the virtualisation console
Check the monitoring tool for CPU, memory and disk alerts before the failure
Check whether a patch or change ran on the server recently
resolution_steps: Open the VM console and check whether the operating system is responsive
Restart the hung service or reboot the server in an approved window
Start the VM and review the boot error if it fails to start
Roll back the most recent change if the problem started after it
escalation_criteria: Escalate to Infrastructure Operations if a production server cannot be recovered within 30 minutes.

title: Internal web application shows HTTP 500, 502 or a sign-in loop
symptoms: Page shows HTTP 500 Internal Server Error
Page shows 502 Bad Gateway or service unavailable
Application keeps redirecting back to the sign-in page
diagnostic_steps: Check whether other users see the same error
Check the application status page and recent deployments
Ask the user for the error ID and the time it happened
resolution_steps: Ask the user to clear browser cookies for the site and sign in again
Try a private browser window to rule out a cached session
Restart the application pool or service if the error affects all users
Send the error ID and time to the application team for log analysis
escalation_criteria: Escalate to Application Support if many users are affected or the error continues after a restart.

title: Repeated account lockouts caused by saved old passwords
symptoms: Account locks again minutes after being unlocked
Lockouts started after a password change
Lockouts happen even when the user is not signing in
diagnostic_steps: Find the lockout source computer in the domain controller security log
Check the phone mail app and other devices for saved old passwords
Check mapped drives and scheduled tasks that use the user's credentials
resolution_steps: Update or remove the old password on the phone mail app
Clear saved credentials in Windows Credential Manager
Disconnect and remap network drives with the new password
Unlock the account once all sources are fixed
escalation_criteria: Escalate to Identity & Access Management if the lockout source cannot be found.

title: Add a printer or fix a failed printer driver installation
symptoms: Cannot add the printer from the print server
Printer driver installation fails
Printer shows offline on the laptop although it is on
diagnostic_steps: Check that the laptop can reach the print server
Check whether the printer driver is approved and available on the print server
Check whether the printer was renamed or moved to another print server
resolution_steps: Remove the old printer from Settings and add it again from the print server
Install the approved driver from the Software Center
Restart the Print Spooler service on the laptop
Set the printer as default and print a test page
escalation_criteria: Escalate to End-User Computing if the driver fails to install from the Software Center.

title: SAP short dump or slow SAP transactions
symptoms: Transaction ends with a short dump
SAP transactions are very slow or time out
Posting fails with a runtime error
diagnostic_steps: Look up the short dump in transaction ST22
Check work process usage in transaction SM50
Check whether a transport or batch job ran just before the problem
resolution_steps: Send the short dump ID from ST22 to SAP Basis
Ask the user to retry the transaction after the batch job finishes
End long-running work processes only after the owner agrees
Apply the SAP note named in the dump if one is listed
escalation_criteria: Escalate to SAP Basis if many users are affected or the dump repeats after a retry.

title: Wi-Fi keeps dropping or is connected with no internet
symptoms: Wireless connection drops every few minutes
Wi-Fi is connected but there is no internet
Wi-Fi is weak in meeting rooms
diagnostic_steps: Check whether other users in the same area have the same problem
Check the access point status for that floor in the wireless controller
Check whether the laptop wireless driver is up to date
resolution_steps: Turn Wi-Fi off and on and reconnect to CORP-WIFI
Update the wireless network driver from the Software Center
Disable power saving for the wireless adapter in Device Manager
Report the floor and room to Network Operations if several users are affected
escalation_criteria: Escalate to Network Operations if an access point is down or a whole floor is affected.
